about: Peak wind gust of each storm in the damage data, used to place a forecast on the storm-strength scale. Generated by scripts/calibrate_weather.py. Multipliers here are for reference; the API reads the engine's own presets.
source: Open-Meteo archive (reanalysis), hourly wind_gusts_10m, mph, UTC

point.note: centre of the service area, rounded to 0.05 degrees
